idu_rule: per event_id: sum of 'Recommended figure' rows if any; otherwise the latest 'Triangulation' figure per location (by created_at), summed
gidd_rule: flows = sum of 'Internal Displacements' figures (unique figure ID); stock = sum of 'Total number of IDPs' figures of the latest year that has one
sorting: gidd_flows, or idu_flows when the event is not in GIDD, largest first
note: One row per IDMC event. GIDD (validated) and IDU (provisional) are separate columns and are never added together. Event-level GIDD rows are complete from 2023; earlier years may show fewer GIDD events.
